"""Extract closed tiny-copy evidence; preserve every original outcome."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('compact_copy_owner', O)
M = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(M)


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


def extract(text, label):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    errors = [s for s in lines if 'ERROR (' in s]
    expected = [s for s in errors if 'ZE_RESULT_NOT_READY' in s and 'in zeEventQueryStatus(' in s]
    unexpected = [s for s in errors if s not in expected]
    sysman = [s for s in unexpected if label == 'device-selected' and (
        'ERROR (ZE_RESULT_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS) in zesDeviceEnumEngineGroups(' in s
        or 'ERROR (ZE_RESULT_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE) in zesDeviceGetEccState(' in s)]
    assert len(unexpected) == len(sysman), unexpected
    return dict(bytes=len(text.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                non_api_messages=[s for s in lines if s and not re.match(r'^\[.*\] \[thread-id:', s)],
                api_line_count=sum(bool(re.match(r'^\[.*\] \[thread-id:', s)) for s in lines),
                expected_not_ready_count=len(expected), unexpected_compute_api_errors=[], sysman_discovery_diagnostics=sysman,
                expected_not_ready_example=expected[:1])


def association(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    marker = [s for s in lines if 'native copy-only queue selected group=' in s]
    assert len(marker) == 1 and 'group=1 ' in marker[0] and 'ownership=keep' in marker[0]
    creates = [(i, s) for i, s in enumerate(lines) if 'SUCCESS (ZE_RESULT_SUCCESS)' in s
               and 'in zeCommandListCreateImmediate(' in s and 'ordinal=1,' in s]
    assert len(creates) == 1
    ci, create = creates[0]
    handle = re.search(r'phCommandList=(0x[0-9a-f]+)', create).group(1)
    related = [(i, s) for i, s in enumerate(lines) if 'SUCCESS (ZE_RESULT_SUCCESS)' in s
               and re.search(r'hCommandList=' + re.escape(handle) + r'[,)]', s)]
    copies = [(i, s) for i, s in related if 'in zeCommandListAppendMemoryCopy(' in s]
    sizes = [int(re.search(r'\bsize=(\d+)', s).group(1)) for _, s in copies]
    assert sizes == [1056, 1024]
    assert not any('in zeCommandListAppendLaunch' in s for _, s in related)
    syncs = [(i, s) for i, s in related if 'in zeCommandListHostSynchronize(' in s]
    destroys = [(i, s) for i, s in related if 'in zeCommandListDestroy(' in s]
    assert syncs and len(destroys) == 1
    assert ci < copies[0][0] < copies[1][0] < syncs[-1][0] < destroys[0][0]
    return dict(group_ordinal=1, handle=handle, marker=marker[0], copies_bytes=sizes,
                successful_native_kernel_launch_count=0, destroy_count=1,
                create_copy_drain_destroy_order=True,
                selected_success_api_lines=[create] + [s for _, s in copies] + [syncs[-1][1], destroys[0][1]],
                scope='Actual normal native-list association/drain/destruction only; no UR exception-leak proof')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-tiny-qualification-root-v3'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    result = dict(active=False, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True,
                  model_executed=False, model_qualified=False, adopted=False, reset_executed=False,
                  originals=[], compact_receipts=[], cases={}, native_associations={})
    for version in (1, 2, 3):
        p = B / f'main-native-copy-queue-tiny-root-v{version}' / 'record.json'
        data = json.loads(p.read_text())
        assert not data['active']
        assert all(M.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in data['commands'])
        if version > 1:
            assert data['passed'] and data['complete'] and data['boot_unchanged']
            assert all(not c['fault_entries'] and not c['dump_present'] for c in data['kernel_checks'].values())
        else:
            assert not data['passed'] and not data['complete']
        compact = copy.deepcopy(data)
        compact['artifact_transformation'] = 'Successful API histories summarized; original outcome and all ownership/fault/source evidence preserved'
        for label, evidence in compact['evidence'].items():
            evidence['stderr_summary'] = extract(evidence.pop('stderr'), label)
        target = out / f'tiny-root-v{version}-compact.json'
        dump(target, compact)
        result['originals'].append(dict(path=str(p), sha256=M.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size,
                                       passed=data['passed'], complete=data['complete'], active=data['active']))
        result['compact_receipts'].append(dict(path=str(target), sha256=M.sha(target)))
        if version > 1:
            result['cases'].update(data['cases'])
            for name in data['cases']:
                if 'ROUTE native=1' in data['evidence'][name]['stdout']:
                    result['native_associations'][name] = association(data['evidence'][name]['stderr'])
            for key in ('source_revision', 'source_pins', 'qualification_receipts', 'boot_id',
                        'expected_provider_libraries', 'expected_library_hashes'):
                assert key not in result or result[key] == data[key]
                result[key] = data[key]
    assert len(result['cases']) == 6 and len(result['native_associations']) == 3
    result.update(passed=True, complete=True, native_tiny_route_qualified=True,
                  raw_api_history_question_resolved=True, finished_utc=M.utc(),
                  scope='Tiny copy/events/canaries/role and normal native-list teardown; no model/speed/quality/full-context qualification',
                  owner='Main', consumer='Next bounded >=32768-token native-copy Prefill model diagnostic',
                  byte_budget=2 << 20, next_review='After model diagnostic admission')
    dump(out / 'record.json', result)
    dump(out / 'retention.json', dict(raw_exception=dict(
        owner='Main', consumer='In-progress SourceOnly model controller agent may read original tiny receipts',
        paths=result['originals'], byte_budget=4 << 20,
        next_review='Agent FINAL; retire full receipts after compact proof references replace consumers'),
        compact_consumer=result['consumer'], last_required_input_removed=False))
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=result['passed'], cases=len(result['cases']),
                         record=str(out / 'record.json'), sha256=M.sha(out / 'record.json'))))
